metadata.description: Logs Ingestion API resources for FabricObserver. Generated by Build-LogAnalyticsTemplates.ps1; do not edit by hand.
Existing Log Analytics workspace in this resource group.
Destination custom table name, ending in _CL.

true: create a new table (fresh setup or dual write). The name must not be an existing table. false: send to an existing converted table (single write); missing standard columns are added and existing columns are kept. Adding columns can stop legacy ingestion for the entire table. This is a one-way migration; use dual write if legacy rollback is required.
Name of the data collection rule to create or update.
Region of the data collection rule. Must be the workspace region.
Optional data collection endpoint resource ID (required for Private Link). Empty: the DCR provides its own ingestion endpoint.
Optional resource ID of an existing user-assigned managed identity (any resource group or subscription). Empty: create or reuse the identity named by managedIdentityName in this resource group.

User-assigned managed identity to create or reuse in this resource group. Use the same name for FabricObserver and ClusterObserver so both share one identity. Ignored when existingManagedIdentityResourceId is set.
true: grant the identity Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the DCR (the deployer needs permission to assign roles, such as Owner or User Access Administrator). false: grant it separately.
